# groups

Rail groups: sections, header summary and popover, select mode, filter, group create, rename, ungroup and delete, persistence.

Read first: `docs/features/groups/spec.md`, `docs/features/groups/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/rail-filter-and-selection-are-window-state` — The rail's All · Groups · Ungrouped filter and the select-mode selection are per-window client state, never a preference; the filter resets to All on reload. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-filter-and-selection-are-window-state.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-group-name-click-does-not-fold` — A click on a renameable group's name does not fold its section, so a double-click can rename it; the rest of the header still folds. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-group-name-click-does-not-fold.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-groups-daemon-rows-whole-list-broadcast` — Rail groups are daemon rows broadcast whole as one groups message on every change; membership is a per-session groupId riding the session upsert. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, connection, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-groups-daemon-rows-whole-list-broadcast.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-new-group-is-named-before-it-exists` — The rail's inline new-group editor is a client-pending section; nothing is sent until Enter with a non-empty name, so the daemon never holds an unnamed group. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-new-group-is-named-before-it-exists.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-pin-invariant-scoped-per-section` — Pinned-before-unpinned holds within each section; railPos stays unique over all sessions, and a section's rebuild reuses the values it already holds. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-pin-invariant-scoped-per-section.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-section-headers-drag-in-both-sort-modes` — Section headers drag to reorder sections in both sort modes because section order is user-owned in both; cards keep dragging in manual mode only. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-section-headers-drag-in-both-sort-modes.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-select-mode-disables-card-drag` — While select mode is on, rail cards are not draggable and the pin control is hidden; moves go through the selection bar. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-select-mode-disables-card-drag.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-select-mode-persists-across-bar-actions` — Move to, Ungroup, Stop and Remove from the selection bar leave select mode and the selection on; only Done, Escape, Tiles or an empty rail end it. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, actions, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-select-mode-persists-across-bar-actions.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-summary-dot-order-is-attention-order-idle-once` — A section header's summary lists states in attention order with idle counted once, after working, and ended members last under a neutral dot. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-summary-dot-order-is-attention-order-idle-once.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-ungrouped-is-section-zero-on-the-wire` — Group endpoints address the Ungrouped section as id 0; a session with no group has groupId null; Ungrouped's place and collapsed flag persist in kv. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-ungrouped-is-section-zero-on-the-wire.md`
- `kb:adr/web-menu-component-single-builder` — One menu builder serves every dashboard menu — rail ⋯, header ⋯, Move to and the Focus-header control — and the design system gains a Menu component. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, focus, actions, groups) → `docs/adr/web-menu-component-single-builder.md`
